<script>
// The tab strip scrolls. Keep the fade honest about which end still has tabs
// behind it, and let a plain mouse wheel move it - a trackpad can swipe
// sideways, a wheel cannot, and there is no visible scrollbar to drag.
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var nav = document.querySelector('nav');
  if (!nav) return;
  function edges() {
    var more = nav.scrollWidth - nav.clientWidth;
    nav.classList.toggle('ovf-r', more > 2 && nav.scrollLeft < more - 2);
    nav.classList.toggle('ovf-l', nav.scrollLeft > 2);
  }
  nav.addEventListener('scroll', edges, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', edges);
  nav.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
    if (nav.scrollWidth <= nav.clientWidth) return;
    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) <= Math.abs(e.deltaX)) return;   // already horizontal
    nav.scrollLeft += e.deltaY;
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  edges();
  // The workspace profile and the account gate both hide buttons after this
  // runs, and web fonts land later still - both change the strip's width.
  setTimeout(edges, 400); setTimeout(edges, 1500);
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(edges);
})();
</script>
